supporting_observations.claim: The observed periodic HTTPS activity is to update.stockpilot.com, an approved update service; proxy records show successful CONNECTs at 13:40:34, 13:45:29, 13:50:06, 13:56:02, 14:00:47, and 14:10:11 UTC.

The updater process observed on WS-EBROOKS-01 is C:\Program Files\StockPilot\stockpilotupd.exe, running as eli.brooks; its recorded outbound connections to the explicit proxy align with the StockPilot HTTPS activity.
The connection spacing is consistent with the inventory's stated roughly five-minute StockPilot update-check cadence. The 14:06:01 attempt returned proxy status 502, so not every attempt succeeded.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records for StockPilot show CONNECT tunnel metadata, not the encrypted HTTPS request or response contents.
The supplied records show the attributed StockPilot sequence beginning at 13:40:34 UTC; they do not establish the process or destination for any alerted connections before that time.
claims_not_established: The contents or purpose of data exchanged inside the successful StockPilot TLS tunnels are not visible in these records.
The supplied evidence does not attribute any possible alerted HTTPS connections from 13:30 to before 13:40 UTC.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox updater activity is present on WS-EBROOKS-01, although Dropbox is not among the approved services; review separately whether this installation or service is authorized. Records: T216-00024, T216-00173, T216-00257.

GlobalProtect-related activity is present, including a connection to updates.paloaltonetworks.com and a later PanGPA process launch; review separately against the no-VPN policy. Records: T216-00030, T216-00266, T216-00267.

eli.brooks opened a Google Sheets URL in Chrome and the proxy recorded a successful request to docs.google.com; Google Sheets is not listed as an approved service. Review separately. Records: T216-00304, T216-00309, T216-00310.
